findings.title: YAML serialization requirement is not fully assigned
findings.description: The round-trip test checks only the reloaded policy. The design requires `config_to_yaml` to emit a **plain string** and reload an equal `ServerConfig`. The tasks do not direct an implementation change to `config_to_yaml` if needed, nor do they assert either requirement. Extend the task to verify the emitted YAML and full config equality, and update serialization as necessary.

findings.title: Manual verification can undo the required shipped default
findings.description: Task 5.2 allows restoring `config/test.yaml` to any policy, while the design requires it to ship with `wrap`. Require restoration to `wrap` and verify it before closeout.

findings.title: Commit markers are checkboxes rather than plain lines
findings.description: All five `**Commit**:` markers are nested in checkbox items. Make them plain lines at their existing tested checkpoints, rather than checkboxes.

findings.title: Breakdown is overly granular for the slice
findings.description: The enum, its single config field, and loader are separate implementation tasks with low-level instructions; the plan also repeats full-suite execution and specifies a large number of individually named tests. Merge the config implementation tasks, consolidate related policy cases with parametrization where appropriate, and remove redundant full-suite runs while retaining the required coverage and final verification.
